description: This file defines the base class PEAR_Installer_Role_Common for managing installation roles within the PEAR package system, including methods for processing installation paths, retrieving configuration info, and checking role attributes.

classes.name: PEAR_Installer_Role_Common
classes.description: Base class for all installation roles, providing methods for configuration, path processing, and role attribute checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the role with a configuration object.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves configuration info for a given role.

methods.name: processInstallation
methods.description: Calculates installation paths and file locations based on role info and attributes.

methods.name: getLocationConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration variable name for the file location.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Placeholder for any special setup procedures for the role.

methods.name: isExecutable
methods.description: Checks if the role is marked as executable.

methods.name: isInstallable
methods.description: Checks if the role is marked as installable.

methods.name: isExtension
methods.description: Checks if the role is marked as a PHP extension.
